analysis_result.analysis: The model failed primarily due to misinterpreting the temporal structure of the video. It treated each shape’s display time as its duration, ignoring the actual drawing start and end timestamps provided in the scene description. This led to uniformly incorrect 2.0s durations for all shapes. Additionally, the model hallucinated colors and mislabeled the diamond as a parallelogram, indicating perceptual inaccuracies. The core failure stems from a wrong premise about what 'duration' means in context — conflating display persistence with drawing time — which cascaded into all subsequent calculations.
